answer: In the basalt agent market, each identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to receive one daily bidding slot. A public beacon marks the epochs when deposits unlock, and a positive balance delta cannot create extra slots before the lock expires. Splitting funds among fake identities therefore buys no free capacity: running 1,000 identities ties up 100,000 tokens, imposing financing costs and token-price risk on the attacker.
